title: First-Run Guided Journey: Visual Assets & Empty-State Patterns for Console
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Goal: Ship a cohesive first-run guided journey for the Redwood Console that reduces time-to-first-success for new developer signups. This ticket covers visual assets, empty-state illustrations, checklist flows, tip copy, and annotated screenshots for handoff to engineering and content.
problem_statement: New users land in the Console with powerful capabilities but often face cognitive load: unclear next steps, underused rollouts, and no clear indication of value (cost/latency dashboards hidden). We need a light-weight, branded guided journey that surfaces a simple checklist, contextual tips, and clear empty-state affordances so users can complete a minimal set of actions (connect creds, create a route, run a sample inference) within 10 minutes.
scope: Design and deliver: (1) a first-run checklist panel (persistent on top/right), (2) 3 empty-state illustrations + copy variants (Routes, Models, Billing), (3) inline tips tooltips for 6 critical controls, (4) 4 annotated screenshots for engineering integration and QA, (5) a small assets package (SVGs, 2x PNGs for legacy) and content copy for i18n. Excludes: onboarding emails, backend telemetry implementation, and full analytics tracking (covered by ENG-3012).
acceptance_criteria: Checklist appears on first console load and can be dismissed or re-opened from Help menu
Empty states delivered for Routes/Models/Billing with two copy variants (concise + instructional)
Tooltips attached to specified controls with copy under 120 characters and keyboard focusable
Assets provided as SVG + 2x raster exports; filenames follow asset naming convention (onboarding_empty_routes_v1.svg)
Annotated screenshots include selector references and expected component states for dev QA
Design handoff in Figma with tokens mapped to Redwood variables; assets added to Drive and linked in ticket
deliverables: Figma file: Console Onboarding > First-Run Guided Journey (finalized frames)
Assets ZIP: svg/png exports and screenshot overlays
Copy variants file: concise + instructional + a11y alt text
Handoff doc: selectors + screenshots + integration notes
Design review notes and sign-off from PM + Eng
ux_notes: Keep interactions minimal: checklist items unlock context panes instead of full modals. Use soft-brand color (redwood-green-50) for success states and amber-100 for pending items. Empty-state illustrations should avoid depicting specific hardware or provider logos. All copy needs one-sentence concise variant for microcopy and an instructional variant for the checklist detail view.
engineering_notes: Front-end will read feature flag 'onboarding_first_run' and show checklist for accounts with less than 3 routes. We will surface selectors in handoff doc. Tooltips should be accessible (aria-describedby) and dismissible with Esc. ENG-3012 owns telemetry and event names; make sure event names match the schema in the dependency ticket.
i18n: Provide source strings in English; Sana will produce context notes for translators. Avoid idioms and contractions. Asset text layers must be editable (no flattened text in SVGs).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overwhelming users with checklist length. Mitigation: Keep to 4 core items and allow user to dismiss permanently. Risk: Accessibility gaps with tooltips. Mitigation: a11y review scheduled with accessibility engineer and keyboard flows documented.
feedback_summary: 2025-11-20 PM review: reduce checklist to 4 items; reorder: Connect creds -> Create route -> Run sample -> Review costs
2025-11-24 Eng review: tooltip placement must avoid overlapping token-level metrics; suggest anchor points for each control
2025-11-27 Design critique: prefer flat 2-color illustrations to stay consistent with product aesthetic
updates: 2025-11-13: Kickoff with PM and Eng. Agreed success metric: increase first-route creation rate by +18% in first 7 days.
2025-11-18: First sketch explorations completed; uploaded to Figma. Link added to mockup_urls.
2025-11-20: PM gave prioritization feedback; checklist reduced to 4 items.
2025-11-24: Engineering alignment meeting — decided to use feature flag and account threshold rule; eng will stub selectors in staging.
2025-11-30: Final illustration pass complete; exported SVGs and added to Drive. QA checklist written.
2025-12-03: Design handoff meeting scheduled; Sana to deliver final copy. Liam to start implementation sprint 2025-W50.
qa_notes: QA should validate: checklist visibility on new accounts, dismiss and re-open behavior, tooltip keyboard focus, screenreader announcements for new checklist items, and that asset SVGs scale without text truncation. Include pixel-diff screenshots for annotated frames.
next_steps: 1) Finalize copy (Sana) by 2025-12-05. 2) Engineering to implement feature flag and selectors stub by 2025-12-08. 3) Run small beta (10 accounts) and gather qualitative feedback. 4) Iterate and prepare for console-2025.12 release.
notes: Avoid adding product tour overlays that block core UI controls; prefer non-modal flows. Keep analytics minimal for the first release to respect privacy and reduce data noise.
